title: fix(rest): keep a nullValues sentinel blank through an inline case transform
body:
Fixes #25611

Clause-②: no
Metadata-protocol: none

## What

`applyInlineEntryRules` (`packages/rest/src/import-prepare.ts`) ran an inline entry's `transform` on a string cell first and the blank test second. Core's `isBlank` matches a `nullValues` entry exactly (raw or trimmed spelling), so `uppercase` / `lowercase` rewrote a sentinel out of being one: with `nullValues: ['n/a']` and `transform: 'uppercase'`, the cell `n/a` became `N/A` and was stored as a value, skipping the entry's `defaultValue`, cell coercion's null handling, and `required`.

The fix judges blankness on the raw cell and transforms only a non-blank string cell. A sentinel stays a sentinel through `defaultValue`, `required` and cell coercion; a non-blank cell is transformed exactly as before (including a cell whose transformed spelling matches a sentinel, which is blank afterwards as it was before). `packages/core/src/utils/import-coerce.ts` is untouched: `isBlank` keeps its exact-match semantics for every import door.

## Proof

Six new pins in `packages/rest/src/import-inline-mapping-entry.test.ts`, through the real `POST /api/v1/data/:object/import` route handler on sqlite `:memory:`, for `uppercase` (sentinel `n/a`) and `lowercase` (sentinel `N/A`):

- the sentinel cell is stored unset (`null`), and a non-sentinel cell in the same request is still transformed (`Jp` to `JP` / `jp`) — the control;
- with `defaultValue`, the sentinel cell takes the default;
- with `required: true`, the request is refused `400` `MISSING_REQUIRED_FIELD` and nothing is written.

- Before the fix (test commit `a5c8099acc`): `Tests 6 failed | 8 passed (14)`, e.g. `expected 'N/A' to be null`, `expected 'n/a' to be 'cn-default'`, `expected undefined to be 400`.
- After the fix (`a0b29be00d`): `Test Files 1 passed (1)`, `Tests 14 passed (14)`; the eight existing cases stay green.
- Ablation (on `a0b29be00d`, via `scripts/ablation-replace.mjs`, anchor 1 to 0, blob `56b834253a13` to `a7b8d42cf5e5`): old order restored, `Tests 6 failed | 8 passed (14)`; restored by `git checkout HEAD`, blob back to `56b834253a1304b3b88231bb4b191009fca22a75` = HEAD blob, `git diff HEAD` empty. The suite imports `./rest-server` from source, so no `dist/` leg applies.
- `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest test` on `a0b29be00d`: `Test Files 320 passed (320)`, `Tests 6406 passed | 326 skipped`; `pnpm --filter @objectstack/rest typecheck`: exit 0; eslint on both touched files: exit 0.
- `dispatch-gates --commands` on `a0b29be00d`: 68 commands run, 67 exit 0; `pnpm check:dual-build-cjs-loads` exit 3 `PREREQUISITE NOT MET` (it needs a whole-workspace `dist/`, only the rest closure was built) — NOT MEASURED locally, left to CI's `Lint & Repo Gates`. `--ran` reconciliation: 68 of 68 accounted for.

## Acceptance notes

- A whitespace-only cell under `transform: 'trim'` is now left as is rather than trimmed to an empty string by the entry; both spellings are blank to `isBlank` and to cell coercion, so the stored outcome is unchanged.
